name: boa_constrictor_coiled
description: Boa constrictor coiled in a three-loop heap (recolour of anaconda_coiled for 042): tan/light brown body with dark reddish-brown saddles, cream belly, dark brown outline, head at about (+200,-250) facing right. Anchor bottom-centre (lowest coil on y=0), ~560x300 (x -280..280, y -300..0). Use where the narration says "boa" so it reads differently from the olive green anaconda.
